title: Orchard and Tide
author: Juniper Dunmore
blurb: Bram Nystrom, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
